ui_bugs.issue: TIMEZONE BUG: Frontend todayStr() uses new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) which returns UTC date, while backend /attendance/today uses WIB (UTC+7). When UTC day != WIB day (e.g. during ~17:00-23:59 UTC), markSelf posts {date: UTC-date} but /attendance/today looks up WIB-date → mismatch. Result: after clicking Izin/Sakit the detail list gets the record (loadList uses month only) but attendance-today-status badge never shows; the Absen Masuk + Izin + Sakit buttons remain visible. Reproduced live: kasir, pod WIB=2026-10-09 00:04, UTC=2026-10-08 17:04 — clicked attendance-izin-button, detail table shows '08 Okt 2026 Izin' but today card still shows the three buttons. Same bug affects: Absensi Hari Ini date header (shows UTC date, not WIB), admin mark.date default, admin check-in guard (loadToday returns null so Absen Masuk + Izin + Sakit always available on days where UTC lags WIB).

action_items: Fix timezone bug in /app/frontend/src/lib/format.js: todayStr() should return WIB date (UTC+7) to match backend wib_now(). E.g. `new Date(Date.now() + 7*3600*1000).toISOString().slice(0,10)` or use Intl.DateTimeFormat with Asia/Jakarta.

After fix, verify (a) attendance-today-status badge appears after clicking Izin/Sakit when UTC/WIB days differ; (b) Absensi Hari Ini header shows WIB date; (c) admin mark-date-input defaults to WIB today.

rca of the issue: RCA: Frontend `todayStr()` in /app/frontend/src/lib/format.js uses JavaScript's `new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)` which returns the UTC-based date. Backend uses `wib_now()` (Asia/Jakarta, UTC+7). During the window 17:00-23:59 UTC (00:00-06:59 WIB next day), UTC-date is 1 day behind WIB-date. The /attendance/today handler queries by backend WIB date, but the frontend posts /attendance/mark with UTC date and renders the 'Absensi Hari Ini' header using UTC date. Result: the mark is stored on UTC date, /attendance/today (WIB date) returns null, UI never shows the status badge. Repro: set system such that UTC and WIB fall on different days (as in current pod: UTC=2026-10-08 17:04, WIB=2026-10-09 00:04), login kasir, go to /kehadiran, click Izin — detail list shows new row for UTC date but today card still shows Absen Masuk + Izin + Sakit. Fix: in format.js change todayStr to produce WIB date, e.g. `const d = new Date(Date.now()+7*3600*1000); return d.toISOString().slice(0,10);` (or use Intl API with timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta').
